source.source_title: Draft Integration of Renewable Resources Report — Appendix G, Tehachapi Transmission Plan
source.scope: A partial 2007 project baseline: one Tehachapi aggregate and fourteen Appendix G Table 1 planned facilities. The report says the CAISO Board approved the plan in January 2007. It is not a complete 2007 annual-plan inventory.

records.status: 2007 Tehachapi plan baseline — Board-approved aggregate project
records.target_isd: Full build-out planned in 2013; component schedule spans 2008–2013
records.path_scope: Board-approved Tehachapi plan; Appendix G describes a phased transmission expansion for renewable interconnection and reliability.
records.capacity: Board-approved plan: 4,350 MW planned generation. Report summary: planned $1.8B upgrades sufficient for up to 5,000 MW.
records.cost_method: Report's $1.8B Tehachapi-area upgrade aggregate; not allocated to component facilities
records.source_locator: caiso_draft_renewables_integration_report_2007.pdf; PDF p. 10, Summary item 1 ($1.8B upgrades / 5,000 MW); Appendix G PDF pp. 140–145 (January 2007 Board approval, 4,350 MW plan, and Table 1 schedule)
records.source_title: Draft Integration of Renewable Resources Report — Appendix G, Tehachapi Transmission Plan
